how: THE READING OF THE UNMARKED LINES, 2026-11-18. These lines stood under record web-wa2-05, verified; no sorter had marked them, so main had not read them one by one. Main read all 990 such lines of the lane against their records' grounds. Narrowed: line 113: the gaps a quarter, a quarter and a half are main's (B1952 part F; the read-out's R); the absolute phases 0, 1/4, 3/4 depend on R's sign and on line 110's constant, which main's read-out does not give as the note has it.
